book-cipher.context: An open book with one word circled and a row of number dots beneath it. Used for book ciphers and code books, secret messages keyed to a text, cryptography lessons and puzzle games.

cipher-grille.context: A card with rectangular holes cut in it, so only a few letters show through when laid over a page. Used for grille ciphers, stencil codes, hidden messages and redaction or masking ideas.

safe-exchange-zone.context: A signpost with a two-way arrow panel and a security camera mounted on top of the post. Marks monitored spots for safe meetups, online sale handovers, parcel and item swaps.

card-cloning.context: A solid access card with an arrow pointing to a dashed duplicate card. Used for card skimming and cloning warnings, RFID badge copying, fraud alerts and security training.

relay-attack.context: A key fob on the left and a car on the right, with a small relay box above passing zigzag signals to both. Shows keyless entry relay theft, signal extension attacks and wireless security warnings.
